name: Ihsahn
description:
'''Vegard Sverre Tveitan''' (born 10 October 1975), better known by his stage name '''Ihsahn''' ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|i|ʃ|ɑː|n}} {{respell|ee|SHAHN}}), is a Norwegian musician, singer, songwriter, record producer, and composer known for his work with [[black metal]] band [[Emperor (Norwegian band)|Emperor]]. Tveitan is a founding member of [[Thou Shalt Suffer]], where he played guitar and keyboard and sang, and [[Peccatum]], a collaboration with wife and musician [[Starofash|Heidi Solberg Tveitan]], known as [[Starofash]]. Since 2006, Tveitan has focused on solo albums and occasional guest appearances.

Beyond metal music, Tveitan's style includes [[Classical music|classical]], [[Industrial music|industrial]], and [[Progressive music|progressive]] elements. He is a progenitor of [[symphonic black metal]].
